What belongs in an appointment reminder?

Start with the business name so the recipient recognizes the message. Include the service, date and local time. Give the customer one clear way to reach you or move the appointment. SMS works well for the essentials. The email can also give arrival instructions or explain what to bring. For in-person appointments, include the studio address in your final email if customers can easily confuse branches. For remote sessions, check that the time zone and meeting link belong to the same booking.

Set up appointment reminders on Shopify →

Worked example

For a photo shoot tomorrow, a useful text might read “Hi Mia, your portrait session at Pine Studio is tomorrow at 10:00. Need another time? Use the link in your confirmation.” In the email, you could also include the studio entrance and parking instructions.

Appointment Reminder Generator FAQ

Does the generator send the text or email?

It creates copy you can review and paste into your booking or messaging service. Your sending platform controls recipients and delivery time.

Can I reuse one template for several customers?

Yes. Keep a master copy with placeholders for the customer, appointment and time. Match those placeholders to your sending platform’s merge fields, then send yourself a test with a real booking’s details.

How should a two-hour reminder differ from a day-before reminder?

A day-before email gives the customer time to reschedule or prepare. A two-hour text can be shorter, with the service, time and a link for last-minute changes.

Which language should I select for the message?

Choose English, French or Spanish to match the customer’s preferred language. The business name and any date or time you enter are copied as written.

Does the character count predict SMS charges?

It counts characters in the draft before names and links are substituted. Your messaging platform determines encoding, segment count and cost for the actual message.

What should the booking management link open?

Use the customer’s booking details or rescheduling page. Open a test link as a customer and check it shows the intended appointment.
